14: The two loaves: They [meant] about the fruits of the trees, since [the loaves] allow the first fruits to be brought. For we may not bring the first fruits before [Shavuot], as it is written (Exodus 34:22), "the first fruits of the wheat harvest." And I heard that Rabbi Yehudah [here] is according to his reasoning. As Rabbi Yehudah goes according to the one that said in Sanhedrin (70b) [that] the tree from which Adam ate was wheat.
